title: Mutations in PPCS, Encoding Phosphopantothenoylcysteine Synthetase, Cause Autosomal-Recessive Dilated Cardiomyopathy.
judge_reason: The publication reports mutations in PPCS (phosphopantothenoylcysteine synthetase), not PPCDC, and while PPCS is involved in coenzyme A biosynthesis, it is a distinct gene from PPCDC (which may also be called MDS018 or FLJ14585).

title: Grc3 programs the essential endoribonuclease Las1 for specific RNA cleavage.
judge_reason: The abstract mentions that disruption of mammalian Las1 has been linked to X-linked intellectual disability but does not report new human genetic evidence; instead, it presents functional and mechanistic data about Las1 protein function in rRNA processing using yeast and in vitro systems.

title: Has toll-like receptor 4 been prematurely dismissed as an inflammatory bowel disease gene? Association study combined with meta-analysis shows strong evidence for association.
judge_reason: This publication reports a case-control association study of TLR4 polymorphisms (Asp299Gly and Thr399Ile) in inflammatory bowel disease patients (Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis) combined with meta-analysis of previous studies, directly examining the genetic link between TLR4 variants and IBD.

title: The ClinGen Epilepsy Gene Curation Expert Panel-Bridging the divide between clinical domain knowledge and formal gene curation criteria.
judge_reason: This publication is a methodological paper describing the ClinGen Epilepsy Gene Curation Expert Panel's framework and criteria for curating epilepsy genes in general, with no mention of PRICKLE1 or any specific genes.

title: The neuronal channel NALCN contributes resting sodium permeability and is required for normal respiratory rhythm.
judge_reason: This publication describes functional characterization of NALCN in an animal model (mice), demonstrating its role in neuronal excitability and respiratory rhythm, which bears on understanding how NALCN dysfunction could contribute to neurological phenotypes including epilepsy, but does not provide direct human genetic evidence linking NALCN to temporal lobe epilepsy specifically.

title: Twenty bone-mineral-density loci identified by large-scale meta-analysis of genome-wide association studies.
judge_reason: This publication reports a genome-wide association study of bone mineral density and osteoporosis, mentioning ZBTB40 only as one of several loci associated with BMD, with no relevance to neurodevelopmental disorder.

title: Irisin delays the onset of type 1 diabetes in NOD mice by enhancing intestinal barrier.
judge_reason: This publication concerns irisin and intestinal barrier function in type 1 diabetes, mentioning FAM120A only as part of a mechanistic pathway (AMPK/PI3K/AKT) unrelated to Tourette syndrome.

title: TRIM47: molecular characteristics, disease-related mechanisms, and clinical translational value.
judge_reason: The publication focuses on TRIM47's role in cancer biology, tumor microenvironment, and immunological homeostasis, with no mention of cerebral small vessel disease or related cerebrovascular phenotypes.

title: ClinGen expert clinical validity curation of 164 hearing loss gene-disease pairs.
judge_reason: This is a methodological paper describing the ClinGen curation framework and process for 164 hearing loss gene-disease pairs, but does not provide specific human genetic evidence linking ADCY1 to nonsyndromic hearing loss, nor does it mention ADCY1 specifically in the title or abstract.

title: MYH7 variants cause complex congenital heart disease.
judge_reason: This is a case series reporting MYH7 variants identified in three probands and their 12 affected family members with congenital heart disease and related cardiac phenotypes, directly establishing human genetic evidence linking MYH7 to CHD.

title: Molecular genetics of human primary microcephaly: an overview.
judge_reason: This is a review article that mentions CDK6 as one of the genes associated with MCPH loci (specifically MCPH12) and discusses the general molecular genetics and pathophysiology of autosomal recessive primary microcephaly, but does not report original human genetic evidence linking CDK6 variants to affected patients or families.

phenotype: pontocerebellar hypoplasia, hypotonia, and respiratory insufficiency syndrome, neonatal lethal
title: ATAD3 gene cluster deletions cause cerebellar dysfunction associated with altered mitochondrial DNA and cholesterol metabolism.
judge_reason: The publication reports biallelic deletions in the ATAD3 gene cluster (including ATAD3C) in individuals from four unrelated families with fatal congenital pontocerebellar hypoplasia, which is a direct match to the phenotype in question.

title: Altered regional cardiac wall mechanics are associated with differential cardiomyocyte calcium handling due to nebulette mutations in preclinical inherited dilated cardiomyopathy.
judge_reason: This publication uses transgenic mouse models with NEBL mutations to study mechanisms of dilated cardiomyopathy rather than reporting human genetic evidence linking NEBL variants to familial dilated cardiomyopathy in patients or families.

phenotype: channelopathy-associated congenital insensitivity to pain, autosomal recessive
title: Nociception and pain in humans lacking a functional TRPV1 channel.
judge_reason: This publication reports human genetic evidence of two affected individuals carrying homozygous missense mutations in TRPV1 that render the channel nonfunctional, resulting in congenital insensitivity to pain, which directly demonstrates the link between TRPV1 and channelopathy-associated congenital insensitivity to pain, autosomal recessive.

title: Mutation in FBXO32 causes dilated cardiomyopathy through up-regulation of ER-stress mediated apoptosis.
judge_reason: The publication reports a missense homozygous mutation in FBXO32 identified in patients causing dilated cardiomyopathy (advanced heart failure), which constitutes human genetic evidence linking FBXO32 variants to dilated cardiomyopathy.

title: Integrating de novo and inherited variants in 42,607 autism cases identifies mutations in new moderate-risk genes.
judge_reason: The publication identifies 60 genes associated with autism risk, but GIGYF1 (also known as GYF1 or PERQ1) is not mentioned in the title or abstract.

title: Differential expression pattern of the novel serine/threonine kinase, STK33, in mice and men.
judge_reason: The publication reports expression data showing STK33 is highly expressed in testis and spermatogenic epithelia, which bears on a potential link to spermatogenic failure, but does not provide human genetic evidence linking STK33 variants to the phenotype.

title: Rab35 regulates Arf6 activity through centaurin-β2 (ACAP2) during neurite outgrowth.
judge_reason: This publication uses a cellular model (PC12 cells) to study RAB35 function in neurite outgrowth, which is relevant to neurodevelopmental processes, but does not provide human genetic evidence linking RAB35 variants to neurodevelopmental disorder.

title: Investigating the aspartic acid (D) repeat of asporin as a risk factor for osteoarthritis in a UK Caucasian population.
judge_reason: This is a human genetic association study investigating whether the aspartic acid repeat polymorphism in the asporin gene (ASPN) is associated with osteoarthritis susceptibility in a UK Caucasian population through genotyping of patients with end-stage primary OA and controls.

title: CLPB mutations cause 3-methylglutaconic aciduria, progressive brain atrophy, intellectual disability, congenital neutropenia, cataracts, movement disorder.
judge_reason: This publication reports human genetic evidence linking CLPB to a distinct syndrome characterized by 3-methylglutaconic aciduria, progressive brain atrophy, intellectual disability, congenital neutropenia, cataracts, and movement disorder, which is related to but phenotypically distinct from Leigh syndrome, along with supporting animal model and functional data.

title: A novel nonsense variant in the NFE2L1 transcription factor in a patient with developmental delay, hypotonia, genital anomalies, and failure to thrive.
judge_reason: This publication reports a heterozygous nonsense variant in NFE2L1 identified in a patient presenting with multiple clinical features (developmental delay, hypotonia, genital anomalies, and failure to thrive) consistent with a syndromic disease, constituting human genetic evidence linking NFE2L1 to syndromic disease.

phenotype: global developmental delay with or without impaired intellectual development
title: The first prenatal diagnosis of EMC10-Related neurodevelopmental disorder: Expanding the phenotypic and mutational spectra through a case and literature review.
judge_reason: This publication reports human genetic evidence (novel compound heterozygous variants in EMC10) in patients with EMC10-related neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by global developmental delay and intellectual disability, which are direct matches to the phenotype in question.

title: Mutations in the area composita protein αT-catenin are associated with arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy.
judge_reason: This publication reports human genetic evidence linking CTNNA3 (αT-catenin) to arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy through identification of two mutations in ARVC patients and functional studies demonstrating how these mutations affect protein interactions.

title: Heterozygous variants of CLPB are a cause of severe congenital neutropenia.
judge_reason: This publication reports human genetic evidence linking CLPB to severe congenital neutropenia, not to Leigh syndrome or related phenotypes.

title: Screening of genes encoding junctional candidates in arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy/dysplasia.
judge_reason: The publication screened CTNNA3 as a candidate gene in ARVC/D patients but found no putative mutations, providing negative human genetic evidence that does not establish a link between CTNNA3 and the disease.

phenotype: congenital anomaly of kidney and urinary tract
title: Genomic Amplification of TBC1D31 Promotes Hepatocellular Carcinoma Through Reducing the Rab22A-Mediated Endolysosomal Trafficking and Degradation of EGFR.
judge_reason: This publication focuses on TBC1D31 amplification in hepatocellular carcinoma and its role in EGFR signaling, with no mention of congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract.

title: Panventriculomegaly with a wide foramen of Magendie and large cisterna magna.
judge_reason: The publication reports a DNAH14 deletion that co-segregated with panventriculomegaly patients in a family, establishing human genetic evidence linking DNAH14 to a neurodevelopmental disorder (congenital hydrocephalus with associated neurological symptoms).

title: At physiological expression levels the Kidd blood group/urea transporter protein is not a water channel.
judge_reason: This publication provides functional and molecular characterization data of the Kidd blood group/urea transporter protein (HUT11A, encoded by SLC14A1) through cellular expression studies in Xenopus oocytes, rather than human genetic evidence linking variants to the phenotype.

phenotype: intellectual disability, anterior maxillary protrusion, and strabismus
title: SOBP is mutated in syndromic and nonsyndromic intellectual disability and is highly expressed in the brain limbic system.
judge_reason: The publication reports identification of a truncating SOBP mutation in a family with MRAMS (mental retardation with anterior maxillary protrusion and strabismus) syndrome, directly linking SOBP variants to the specified phenotype in patients.

title: Mutations in prickle orthologs cause seizures in flies, mice, and humans.
judge_reason: The publication reports human genetic evidence linking PRICKLE1 to epilepsy, identifying heterozygous mutations in PRICKLE1 in human epilepsy patients.

title: Development of feline microsatellites and SNPs for evaluating primary cataract candidate genes as cause for cataract in Angolan lions (Panthera leo bleyenberghi).
judge_reason: This publication studies CRYGB as a candidate gene for primary cataracts in an animal model (Angolan lions) and excludes it as causative, providing functional/genetic evidence in a non-human system relevant to cataract phenotypes.

title: Novel CLPB mutation in a patient with 3-methylglutaconic aciduria causing severe neurological involvement and congenital neutropenia.
judge_reason: The publication reports a CLPB mutation in a patient with 3-methylglutaconic aciduria and neurological involvement, which is a related but distinct phenotype from Leigh syndrome, thus bearing on CLPB's role in neurological disease without directly linking it to Leigh syndrome.

title: The Connecdenn DENN domain: a GEF for Rab35 mediating cargo-specific exit from early endosomes.
judge_reason: This publication focuses on the molecular and cellular function of RAB35 as a GEF substrate in endosomal trafficking, with no mention of neurodevelopmental disorder or any human disease phenotype.

title: Rab35-regulated lipid turnover by myotubularins represses mTORC1 activity and controls myelin growth.
judge_reason: This publication provides functional and mechanistic evidence in animal models linking RAB35 to peripheral neuropathy (a neurodevelopmental disorder phenotype) through studies of myelin growth regulation, but does not report human genetic variants in RAB35 patients.

title: A Comprehensive Genomic Analysis Reveals the Genetic Landscape of Mitochondrial Respiratory Chain Complex Deficiencies.
judge_reason: The publication reports identifying MRPS23 as a novel causative gene in patients with childhood-onset mitochondrial respiratory chain complex deficiencies, which is directly relevant to combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 46, a mitochondrial respiratory chain disorder.

title: Polymorphisms of the lipopolysaccharide-signaling complex in inflammatory bowel disease: association of a mutation in the Toll-like receptor 4 gene with ulcerative colitis.
judge_reason: This is a human genetic association study reporting that a functional polymorphism (Thr399Ile) in the TLR4 gene is significantly associated with ulcerative colitis, a subtype of inflammatory bowel disease, in a case-control design with 98 ulcerative colitis patients and 145 healthy controls.

title: Rab-mediated trafficking role in neurite formation.
judge_reason: This is a review article discussing the general role of Rab GTPases (including potentially RAB35) in neurite formation and neuronal development using cellular and animal models, rather than reporting human genetic evidence linking RAB35 to neurodevelopmental disorder.

title: Mutations in ABCB6 cause dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria.
judge_reason: This publication reports ABCB6 mutations in dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria (a pigmentary skin disorder), which is unrelated to microphthalmia, isolated, with coloboma 7 (an ocular developmental disorder).

title: Jinmaitong ameliorates diabetic peripheral neuropathy in streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats by modulating gut microbiota and neuregulin 1.
judge_reason: This is an animal model study (streptozotocin-induced diabetic rats) demonstrating that a traditional Chinese medicine compound ameliorates diabetic peripheral neuropathy through modulation of NRG1 levels and gut microbiota, providing functional/mechanistic evidence linking NRG1 to peripheral neuropathy without human genetic evidence.

title: Vaccinia-related kinase 2 mediates accumulation of polyglutamine aggregates via negative regulation of the chaperonin TRiC.
judge_reason: This publication focuses on VRK2 and its regulation of TRiC in the context of polyglutamine aggregation and Huntington's disease, with no mention of CCT4 (or its alternative symbol Cctd) or complex neurodevelopmental disorder.
